inventory.visualPurpose: Lymph node cross-section (histology micrograph + labeled schematic)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Two printed elements: an H&E micrograph of a lymph node cross-section (arrow A = trabecula) and a labeled schematic showing afferent lymphatic, follicles (1º dense quiescent, 2º active with pale germinal center and mantle zone), paracortex with postcapillary (high endothelial) venule, medullary cords and sinuses, capsule, trabecula, cortex, artery, vein, capillary supply, and efferent lymphatic.

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Anterior body map with node clusters marked (green dots = palpable; circles with green centers = nonpalpable), leader-lined to the adjacent 16-cluster table; plus the two-duct summary text (right lymphatic duct / thoracic duct territories and terminations, chylothorax on rupture).

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Three-column table (Lymph node cluster / Area of body drained / Associated pathology), 16 clusters from submandibular/submental to popliteal, with two merged pathology cells in print (celiac–SM–IM: mesenteric lymphadenitis, IBD, celiac disease; external iliac–internal iliac–superficial inguinal: STIs, medial foot/leg cellulitis [superficial inguinal]).

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Two printed elements: a spleen cross-section diagram (capsule, trabecula, white pulp with follicle [B cells], mantle zone, germinal center, marginal zone, periarteriolar lymphoid sheath [T cells], red pulp with sinusoids and reticular fibrous framework, open and closed circulation, pulp vein, artery, vein) and a neonatal AP chest radiograph showing the sail-shaped thymus (arrows in A).

notes: Census (pdfimages + 150-DPI render + VLM): p116 carries 2 printed elements (micrograph + schematic) consolidated as sv1 (both convey one teaching unit — the zonation); p118 carries 2 printed elements (spleen diagram + neonatal CXR) consolidated as sv4. Histology and radiograph findings are conveyed as original schematics per the rights rule — never reproduced. Table row assignments (mediastinal vs hilar pathology; merged cells) verified by three independent high-resolution VLM reads.
